verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents that admins can enforce a specific 2-Step Verification method for chosen users or groups, including requiring security keys for a team. The evidence never mentions passkeys or FIDO2 by name, and never shows a strong-MFA requirement scoped to specific sensitive apps; Context-Aware Access controls per-app access by other attributes, not by MFA method. Missing for 10: passkey support evidence, explicit FIDO2 documentation, per-app enforcement of a phishing-resistant MFA method, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, MFA goes beyond push codes — FIDO2 security keys and passkeys are supported and can be REQUIRED by policy for sensitive apps
